channel.title: The daily tape · compute.world
channel.description: The constraint in last night's earnings was delivery, not demand. Alphabet said Google Cloud revenue rose 103% to $30.7 billion with TPU system sales a meaningful contributor, and its backlog reached $561 billion, just over 55% of which it expects to book within 24 months. Because supply is tight, Google began using third-party compute at the end of the third quarter and will ramp it in the fourth, at a margin cost. Microsoft grew Azure 48% and commercial remaining performance obligation 73% to $677 billion, but spent $45.2 billion on capex and finance leases against a $50 billion plan because some third-party capacity deliveries slipped, and it said some GPU-as-a-service contracts moved to the second half. This morning Samsung said its 2027 HBM volume is sold out at target prices, a day after SK hynix said the same of more than half its 2027 and 2028 capacity. In London the Budget put a number on sovereign demand: 6 GW of AI data centre capacity by 2030, with grid capacity reserved for sites that meet the new covenant. On the public tape all 70 list prints confirmed; Lambda H100 holds at $3.99 and B200 at $6.69 per GPU-hour.

item.title: Compute brief - 29 October 2026
item.description: The constraint in last night's earnings was delivery, not demand. Alphabet said Google Cloud revenue rose 103% to $30.7 billion with TPU system sales a meaningful contributor, and its backlog reached $561 billion, just over 55% of which it expects to book within 24 months. Because supply is tight, Google began using third-party compute at the end of the third quarter and will ramp it in the fourth, at a margin cost. Microsoft grew Azure 48% and commercial remaining performance obligation 73% to $677 billion, but spent $45.2 billion on capex and finance leases against a $50 billion plan because some third-party capacity deliveries slipped, and it said some GPU-as-a-service contracts moved to the second half. This morning Samsung said its 2027 HBM volume is sold out at target prices, a day after SK hynix said the same of more than half its 2027 and 2028 capacity. In London the Budget put a number on sovereign demand: 6 GW of AI data centre capacity by 2030, with grid capacity reserved for sites that meet the new covenant. On the public tape all 70 list prints confirmed; Lambda H100 holds at $3.99 and B200 at $6.69 per GPU-hour. Countries: United Kingdom: Data Centre Covenant: 6 GW of AI data centre capacity needed by 2030; grid capacity reserved for strategic sites that meet local, efficiency and security tests (Wire, 28 Oct). India: L&T's Vyoma.AI breaks ground on 52 MW in Chennai, next to a live 30 MW facility (Wire, 28 Oct). Brazil: 5G auction fund approves a R$375 million sovereign AI data centre with 48 GPUs, run by Telebras; Anatel board still to approve (Wire, 27 Oct). Seychelles: Cabinet approves a sovereign government cloud on two in-country datacentres (Wire, 28 Oct). South Korea: Only confirmed AI data centre demand goes into the 12th power plan (Wire, 26 Oct).
